fields.q: 不管被打倒多少次，我老哥都会爬起来。那家伙真有骨气！
fields.en: No matter how hard he gets knocked down, my brother keeps gettin' up. He's got spirit, that guy!
fields.name: 哥莱亚斯

q.value: 不管被打倒多少次，我老哥都会爬起来。那家伙真有骨气！

en.value: No matter how hard he gets knocked down, my brother keeps gettin' up. He's got spirit, that guy!

fields.q: 打仗的时候大家都喜欢有我在，平时就不怎么样了。
fields.en: People like having me around in battles, but other than that, usually not.
fields.name: 哥莱亚斯

q.value: 打仗的时候大家都喜欢有我在，平时就不怎么样了。

en.value: People like having me around in battles, but other than that, usually not.

fields.q: 别坐在我手上，我怕把你捏扁。
fields.en: Don't sit on my hand. I'm worried I might squish you.
fields.name: 哥莱亚斯

q.value: 别坐在我手上，我怕把你捏扁。

en.value: Don't sit on my hand. I'm worried I might squish you.

fields.q: 呃，杂活真让人火大！有什么办法能让我舒坦点？
fields.en: Ugh, busywork makes me so mad! Is there some way for me to feel better?
fields.name: 哥莱亚斯

q.value: 呃，杂活真让人火大！有什么办法能让我舒坦点？

en.value: Ugh, busywork makes me so mad! Is there some way for me to feel better?

fields.q: 喂，要是有人欺负你，跟我说，我把他拧成麻花！
fields.en: Hey, if some bully ever comes at you, you talk to me. I'll twist 'em in knots!
fields.name: 哥莱亚斯

q.value: 喂，要是有人欺负你，跟我说，我把他拧成麻花！

en.value: Hey, if some bully ever comes at you, you talk to me. I'll twist 'em in knots!

fields.q: 我头好晕……别人一讲复杂的事，我就头昏。
fields.en: My head's spinning… When people talk about stuff that's complicated, I get dizzy.
fields.name: 哥莱亚斯

q.value: 我头好晕……别人一讲复杂的事，我就头昏。

en.value: My head's spinning… When people talk about stuff that's complicated, I get dizzy.

fields.q: 我从不偷懒不训练。身体练好了，就没有做不到的事！
fields.en: I never forget to train. If your body's in shape, there's nothing you can't do!
fields.name: 哥莱亚斯

q.value: 我从不偷懒不训练。身体练好了，就没有做不到的事！

en.value: I never forget to train. If your body's in shape, there's nothing you can't do!

fields.q: 我以前那个部族的族长是个混蛋。你要是见到他就告诉我，我去揍晕他。
fields.en: The chief of my old tribe was a jerk. If you ever see him, let me know, and I'll knock him out.
fields.name: 哥莱亚斯

q.value: 我以前那个部族的族长是个混蛋。你要是见到他就告诉我，我去揍晕他。

en.value: The chief of my old tribe was a jerk. If you ever see him, let me know, and I'll knock him out.

fields.q: 听说我身上流着巨人的血。哇哈哈，真好笑！
fields.en: They say I got giant's blood. Bwahaha. It's funny!
fields.name: 哥莱亚斯
